thread:
morgan: Heads up — after the schema refactor roll forward I see ~0.6% of new accounts with an empty default_role_id instead of the expected 'base:reader'.
eli: ugh. where in the pipeline? DB backfill, api, or seeding?
priya: looks like the migration ran but the app logic that assigns default roles on user-create got a conditional change. snippet from service log: `if (role) user.role = role` — when role === '' it short-circuits.
samir: can we reproduce locally? what about the backfill tool — did it skip rows with null -> ''?
morgan: repro steps: create user via signup flow using the canary flag off, response shows role = "". backfill job shows row_count: 1,234, skipped: 7 where 'role' column = ''.
jen: @priya can you share the migration and backfill job ids? need to correlate with KMS access logs too (we rotate keys yesterday).
priya: migration_id: mig_2026_03_18_v2_roles, backfill_job: backfill-roles-0320. Also seeing KMS requests for decrypt from the migration runner at 02:11 UTC.
ops-bot: deploy-bot reports: canary deploy 'roles-service@v2.18.0' started at 2026-03-20T02:08:12Z, completed 02:10:47Z.
eli: so timing lines up with rotation window. KMS rotation might have caused the runner to fall back to an error path that wrote empty string? Any error logs?
priya: error logs show a swallowed validation error: `ValidationError: role must be non-empty` inside a try/catch that only logs at debug level.
samir: action plan: 1) surface backfill failures in alerting, 2) run a targeted backfill for empty-string roles, 3) add a canary to block empty-role creates during signup, 4) audit KMS decrypts for the job.
morgan: agree. quick mitigation: add DB constraint to reject empty string (but allow null until backfill completes) — will create constraint: `CHECK (role IS NULL OR role <> '')`.
eli: caution: adding check on prod table with heavy write rate could lock. Run as no-lock validated constraint? postgres: `ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT ... NOT VALID; VALIDATE CONSTRAINT` staged approach.
jen: I'll own coordination with infra for the constraint change and schedule during low traffic window. Tagging @samir for backfill job.
samir: starting targeted backfill now in dry-run mode: `python tools/backfill_roles.py --filter \"role=''\" --dry-run` — result 7,842 rows would be set to 'base:reader'.
priya: post-backfill we'll rotate the migration runner's service account keys again and re-check KMS logs: `gcloud kms keys versions list` + check audit logs for `Decrypt` calls during job.
morgan: also add an alert rule: when percent_of_users_with_role_empty > 0.1% trigger pager.
eli: let's also push a quick sentinel in signup path that rejects empty role assignment and logs at error level so it's visible.
jen: scheduling constraint change for 2026-03-20T05:00Z, backfill dry-run now, live backfill at 05:30Z if dry-run looks good. Ops oncall notified.
ops-bot: oncall: @jen_pager is oncall for 2026-03-20 04:00-08:00 UTC.
priya: after backfill I'll run an audit query to ensure no new '' inserts: `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role = ''` and cross-check with creation_ts > 2026-03-20T02:00Z.
morgan: one more thought — the migration runner was using a cached config that had an empty default role string during a window. We'll add a config schema validation to the runner so empty default roles fail fast.
eli: good. I'll open two PRs: config validation + signup sentinel. priya/samir, keep me posted on backfill results.
priya: dry-run done. counts match. starting live backfill now. will update when complete. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
(10m later) priya: live backfill finished. updated 7,842 rows. post-backfill `SELECT count(*) FROM users WHERE role = ''` -> 0.
samir: re-run the signup smoke tests — all good. no empty roles observed in 1k simulated signups.
morgan: closing the loop: added NOT VALID constraint and validated after backfill. post-validate, 0 violations. added alert and PRs merged for validation + sentinel.
jen: thanks all. follow-up: run KMS audit to confirm no anomalous decrypt errors; escalate if anything odd.
eli: nice quick runbook. will write up a short postmortem doc and link to the migration PRs. :memo:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout metrics: roles-service@v2.18.1 - error_rate 0.02% -> OK, latency unchanged.
morgan: marking thread resolved. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
